headline: Sales and earnings accelerate on broad margin gains
summary_short: Avery Dennison reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $2.46B, up 10.9% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.67 (+10.8% y/y) and adjusted EPS of $2.89, up 19.4%, on margin expansion in both segments.
summary_long: Materials Group sales rose 15.9% (9.7% organic) to $1.80B on volume/mix and price gains, with adjusted operating margin up 20bp to 15.8% as productivity and net pricing/raw-material benefits offset higher employee costs. Solutions Group sales were roughly flat (-0.5%, +2.6% organic) at $667M, but adjusted operating margin jumped 150bp to 11.5% on productivity gains. Net income rose 8.0% y/y to $204.1M; GAAP diluted EPS was $2.67 (+10.8% y/y) and adjusted EPS $2.89 (+19.4% y/y). The company returned $347M to shareholders via buybacks and dividends in H1, with net debt/adjusted EBITDA at 2.3x. Avery Dennison guided FY26 reported EPS of $9.40-$9.70 and adjusted EPS of $10.00-$10.30.

drivers.explanation: Materials Group organic growth of 9.7% (volume/mix plus price) drove the increase; Solutions Group organic growth was a more modest 2.6%.

Adjusted EPS outgrew GAAP EPS as restructuring and other one-off items were excluded; segment margin expansion (Materials +20bp, Solutions +150bp adjusted operating margin) and productivity drove the gain.
Volume, productivity and net pricing/raw-material benefits lifted segment margins, partially offset by higher employee-related costs.
CEO cited stronger-than-anticipated sales growth and margin expansion; company guided FY26 reported EPS of $9.40-$9.70 and adjusted EPS of $10.00-$10.30.
